audit.whatIsWrong: The lane was described as a 'root-into-burst near any wall' problem. Nothing in Ryze's kit involves terrain.
audit.why: Rune Prison (W, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 615 range) slows on its own and only ROOTS if the target already has Flux on them from Spell Flux (E, 3.5s at rank 1, 615 range). Overload (Q, 1000 range, 5s) has its cooldown reset by his other basic abilities.
audit.corrected: Difficulty is a Flux problem, not a wall problem: the E orb landing on you is the tell that the next W is a root rather than a slow, and the root is what cancels your channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike said 'Voice of Light' arrives as a poke-and-zone tool that flips the lane, and the level 6 chart row still gave the stage to Ryze.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's ultimate is Falling Star / The Skies Descend — a 1250-range impact that stuns, on 120/110/100s. It reaches past his 1000-range Overload but it is one cast, not a poke pattern. Realm Warp is 180/160/140s at 3000 range and deals no damage at all.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated as one 120-second stun that narrows the gap rather than flipping it; Realm Warp described as the roam tool it is instead of half of a 'burst kill combo'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated that Rune Prison's root cancels Breath of Light and Astral Flight, nor that the root is conditional on Flux.
audit.why: Both of Aurelion Sol's channels are flagged interruptible, and Rune Prison is the only hard CC Ryze carries. Riot's text: 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.'
audit.corrected: State the sequence: Spell Flux first, then Rune Prison, then the Overload resets. Without Flux on you the W is only a slow and your beam keeps burning — which is exactly when the channel is safe to start.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: Catalogue defect 3. Real numbers: Rune Prison 11s at rank 1, Overload 5s (reset by his other spells), Spell Flux 3.5s at rank 1, Realm Warp 180s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that Aurelion Sol wins 57.07% of 552 games while the chart gave Ryze 5 of 7 stages.
audit.why: The scaling story reads correctly for the last two rows, which the content layer already assigned to Aurelion Sol; the full layer had them backwards.
audit.corrected: Fixing the two layers to agree resolves most of the contradiction — the last two stages now read Aurelion Sol on both, matching the win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows of cross-layer chart disagreement: phases[2].side and phases[4].side read 'Skill' against win[2] and win[4] of 'Ryze', and phases[5].side and phases[6].side read 'Ryze' against win[5] and win[6] of 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: Every one of those rows rendered two different answers to who wins the stage.
audit.corrected: phases[2].side and phases[4].side -> Ryze; phases[5].side and phases[6].side -> Aurelion Sol; ratings and whys rewritten in the same proposal so no row argues with itself. whys[4] also claimed you win level 6 under a Ryze row and was rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles, and dosFull[2].d described his root under a title about matching his roams.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten to match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

notes: Two fabricated mechanics removed. First, the page repeatedly described a 'root-into-burst near any wall' — nothing in Ryze's kit touches terrain; the real condition is Spell Flux, since Rune Prison only roots a target that already has Flux and otherwise just slows. Second, Realm Warp was written as half of a burst kill combo; Riot's text is a portal that teleports allies after a few seconds, 180/160/140s, no damage. 'Voice of Light' is not Aurelion Sol's ultimate (Falling Star / The Skies Descend) and appeared in three content fields. 'Overload+Q' is redundant — Overload IS his Q. Four rows of cross-layer chart disagreement fixed (rows 3, 5, 6 and 7), and whys[4] claimed you win level 6 while both layers gave that row to Ryze; the why was rewritten to agree with its row. The packet's win-rate-versus-chart contradiction is partly resolved by the last two rows now reading Aurelion Sol on both layers; I did not move any middle row on a guess.
